 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Vinod Kumar, Adv
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Pronoti Singh, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Justice Smt. Soni Shrivastava
 Oral Order
The petitioner and Opposite party no. 2 are present along with their counsels.
2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Khizersarai.
P.S Case No. 229 of 2023 registered for the offences punishable under sections 341, 323, 379, 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The petitioner is husband of O.P. No. 2.
After a brief interaction between the parties, it appears that no settlement can be arrived between them at this stage.
The informant has made allegations of demand of dowry and torture in the FIR.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegations made in the FIR is not correct and as a matter of fact, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.42314 of 2024(9) dt.05-05-2025 the petitioner never indulged in any kind of demand of dowry and torture and it is rather the informant, who is creates disturbance in the family, owing to her temperament.
5. The present application is opposed by the learned counsel appearing for the O.P.No.2, who supports the allegations made in the FIR.
6.
At this stage, the learned counsel for the petitioner makes an offer to pay a sum of Rs. 3,500/- per month to the complainant subject to final outcome of any maintenance or collateral proceeding.
